VOYAGER VERSUS v2.8.0 - EXPLICIT CHAT START
23 October 2026

LIVE MATCH FLOW
1. A viewer sends !versus by itself in Twitch chat.
2. The challenger splash appears and reserves that viewer as initiator.
3. A different eligible viewer sends !versus to become challenger.
4. The 10-second countdown starts, followed by the 30-second battle.

The previous !join matchmaking queue and !duel / !accept paths are disabled.
Cooldown expiry and the ready announcement never start a match.
After a match, a fresh !versus is required for the next call.
Test and internal chat events are ignored. Duplicate message IDs are ignored.
Live control-page simulations cannot start games on the shared OBS source.
Open training preview uses a separate browser-only arena for demos and testing.

INSTALL THE SMALL UPDATE
1. Stop the running Voyager launcher in its console with Ctrl+C.
2. Open the Voyager_Giveaway folder in the update ZIP. Copy its contents into
   your existing Voyager_Giveaway folder, replacing matching program files.
   Merge folders; do not delete the existing Voyager_Versus/local/data folder.
3. Run START-VOYAGER-CONTROL.bat again and reconnect Streamer.bot in Versus
   Stream setup. Reload the Versus dock and refresh the OBS Browser Source.
4. Confirm the Versus page shows V2.8.0.
5. Keep the existing live OBS URL:
   http://127.0.0.1:8740/?overlay=1&hideIdle=1
   Do not add demo=1 or preview=1 to that live battle source.

No C# update or new Streamer.bot import is required for this change.
Keep config.js and your original Voyager_Versus/local/data folder.
That folder contains saved rewards, cooldowns, rankings and stream entry usage.
The 45-minute global cooldown, +50 winner / 0 runner-up Voyager points and
one initiator plus one challenger entry per viewer per stream still apply.

The separate versuscall.html ready banner/audio can still play when the game
becomes available, as configured. That announces availability; it does not
open a challenger call or start a battle.

VERIFY
Leave the live game idle: no calling screen or battle should start by itself.
!join and !duel should leave it idle.
Have two different eligible viewers send !versus, in turn.
The first opens the splash; only the second starts the countdown.
Test while the cooldown allows a new call and the stream's role entries remain.

This patch was checked with engine, host, chat, reward and browser tests.
Your actual Streamer.bot and OBS installation still needs the local check above.
